HIGHEST-SEVERITY FINDING (evidence-complete, HEAD). crates/bench/src/kama_product.rs:161/191/224 name three RuntimeConfig fields explicitly, defeating the `..RuntimeConfig::default()` at :231 for exactly those fields. With no CLI flags the `kama-product` arm therefore runs initial_window_bytes=0 (product: 2400), fec_loss_risk disabled (product: bounded_v1 enabled 250/250/Learned/rp300) and structure_gate_level_permille=None→engine 500 (product: 250). scripts/netem/product_vs_quinn.sh:76 labels that arm `kp-sevk` ("shipping"). SECOND FINDING (not in the file scope but decisive for it). The ADR-18 mandatory nightly netem gate (.github/workflows/nightly.yml:129 → harness/run-kama-matrix.sh:20,33) drives `--transport kama`, i.e. crates/bench/src/kama.rs — no crypto (so FEC parity is structurally unemittable, kama.rs:7), no --kama-arm (so tail recovery OFF, sender.rs:1801, while the product ships tail-ON, client-core/src/runtime.rs:675), and no product runtime at all. The quality gate that is supposed to catch transport regressions cannot observe three shipped mechanisms. Pointing the nightly matrix at `kama-product` is the prerequisite for classifying kama.rs DELETE; per CLAUDE.md §6 the module should then be moved to an appendix with MUST NOT IMPLEMENT rather than silently removed.

CLASSIFICATION SEMANTICS. Nothing in crates/bench can be SHIP: the crate is a leaf (verified — no crates/*/Cargo.toml outside crates/bench depends on it, and grep for `bench::` across crates finds nothing), so `called_from_product` is false for every item by construction. I used KEEP-EXPERIMENTAL for measurement infrastructure that is correctly bench-only and still needed, WIRE for items where the harness is architecturally required to reflect the product and does not (the config clobber, the provenance label gap, the MTU asymmetry, the cc label-only stamp, the derived fragmenter), and DELETE for the superseded stub arm and the dead knobs that hang off it.
